description: This file implements the XBSStoreJournal class, managing a journal of device information with file persistence, including methods for updating, loading, and resetting journal entries, as well as handling source types and build time information.

classes.name: XBSStoreJournal
classes.description: A singleton class managing device info journal entries with file storage, supporting updates, resets, and source tracking.

methods.name: getUpdatedSourceString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the source type.

methods.name: rfcUpdateStarted
methods.description: Marks RFC update as started, setting clearRfc flag for relevant entries.

methods.name: rfcUpdateEnd
methods.description: Finalizes RFC update, writing journal entries to file.

methods.name: clearRfcAndGetDefaultValue
methods.description: Clears RFC flag and retrieves default value for a given key.

methods.name: resetClearRfc
methods.description: Resets the clearRfc flag for a specific key.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes a journal record by key.

methods.name: resetCacheAndStore
methods.description: Clears cache and deletes journal file.

methods.name: loadJournalRecordsIntoCache
methods.description: Loads journal entries from file into cache.

methods.name: getJournalSource
methods.description: Returns source type for a given journal key.

methods.name: getBuildTime
methods.description: Retrieves build time from version.txt file.

methods.name: setJournalValue
methods.description: Sets or updates journal value for a key, with source type.

methods.name: setInitialUpdate
methods.description: Sets the initial update mode flag.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the journal by loading from file if not already done.

methods.name: XBSStoreJournal
methods.description: Constructor initializing build time and loading journal.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of XBSStoreJournal, creating if necessary.
